caption:
Brake too soon and the fuel runs out. The Moon hits at 35.2 m/s.

Hovering burns fuel at full weight, every second.
Brake at 430 m with a push of 3x and it lands at 1.0 m/s with 66 s of fuel left.
Brake 20 m too late and it hits at 15.9 m/s.

Save this for later.
